author: Epic Games
description:
CODE EXIT DEMO is now available. Add to your wishlist today! https://epic.gm/code-exit-demo

The high-tech city of Pantheon, once ruled by the integrated AI Minerva, has fallen into chaos.   
Up to four players become investigators of the Hermes team, venturing into the heart of a city now teeming with killing machines.  
Restore systems, recover scattered data, and unearth the truth behind Minerva’s descent into madness.
